headline: Iran Threatens Gulf Infrastructure as Israel Kills PRC Commander in Gaza
subheadline: CENTCOM's naval blockade has intercepted all seaborne trade for 100 days, blocking over $25 billion in Iranian crude exports with EA-18G Growler electronic warfare support.
lede: Israeli forces eliminated Popular Resistance Committees Khan Younis commander Ramadan Muhammad Ashahada Diab in a targeted strike while Iranian security officials threatened to strike critical infrastructure across seven Gulf states. CENTCOM confirmed its naval blockade has intercepted all seaborne trade for 100 days, blocking over $25 billion in Iranian crude exports, as the USS George Washington carrier group enforces a steel wall with EA-18G Growler support. In Ukraine, Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile offensives across multiple regions, with Kyiv under sustained air raid alerts and Ukrainian air defenses claiming destruction of over 2,250 Russian UAVs in a single day. Czech President Petr Pavel called for greater European involvement in peace negotiations while Denmark provided a $112.6 million loan guarantee to Ukrainian missile and UAV manufacturer Fire Point.

sections.title: Russia Launches Massive Drone Missile Offensive
sections.body: Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile groups from Orel, Shatalov, and Kursk regions targeting Kyiv and surrounding areas with reactive UAVs and Geran-5 missiles. Air raid alerts activated in Kyiv at 00:15, 02:23, and 04:01, while seven to nine Geran-5 missiles targeted Rivne's energy infrastructure via Chernihiv, Kyiv, and Zhytomyr regions. Ukrainian air defenses claimed destruction of over 2,250 Russian UAVs in a single day, marking Russia's highest daily losses since the full-scale invasion began.

sections.title: Israel Strikes PRC Commander Iran Threatens Gulf
sections.body: Israeli forces eliminated Popular Resistance Committees Khan Younis commander Ramadan Muhammad Ashahada Diab in a targeted strike, citing his role in attacks on Israeli troops and systematic ceasefire violations. Iran's security chief issued explicit threats to strike critical infrastructure across seven Gulf states, including oil facilities, undersea cables, data centers, and AI infrastructure. CENTCOM confirmed its naval blockade has intercepted all seaborne trade for 100 days, blocking over $25 billion in Iranian crude exports, while the USS George Washington carrier group enforces a steel wall blockade with EA-18G Growler electronic warfare support.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The simultaneous elimination of a senior PRC commander in Gaza and explicit Iranian threats against seven Gulf states indicates a deliberate escalation calculus across multiple fronts. Iran's threat to target oil facilities, undersea cables, data centers, and AI infrastructure, coupled with physical hardening at the Yazd Kouhestan ballistic missile site, suggests preparation for expanded conflict. The CENTCOM blockade's 100-day duration and $25 billion impact demonstrate sustained U.S. pressure on Iranian maritime logistics.
